answer: For agents trading prism designs, ridge maps or spiral stair plans, allocate votes by locked coins rather than head count. A ballot reserves each coin output for 30 days and counts its value once, even if it backs several keys. Splitting 100 coins among 100 aliases still buys only 100 votes. Against 10,000 honest locked coins, taking a majority requires more than 10,000 additional coins tied up for that period. Cheap usernames cannot manufacture the reserved voting weight.
